title: Audit log
description: Server events visible to the current administrator.
coverage: Event coverage is unconfirmed. An empty response may result from access restrictions (RLS), rather than an absence of changes.
filterHint: All text filters use exact matches. Empty fields do not restrict results. Dates and periods use Asia/Almaty. Filters and the page number are saved in the URL.
countUnknown: The server did not report the number of accessible records.

empty.title: The server returned no accessible events
empty.body: No records are visible for these filters and page. An empty response does not prove there were no changes: RLS may restrict access.

notFound.title: Event unavailable
notFound.body: The server did not return this record. It may be missing or hidden by access rules.

validation.period: Unknown period in the URL. Select a period and apply the filters.
validation.dates: Choose valid dates with the start no later than the end. The day after the end date must be representable.
validation.page: Invalid page number in the URL. Apply the filters to start from the first page.

unconfigured.title: Audit log access is not configured
unconfigured.body: Administrator read access has not been confirmed. You can prepare filters in the URL; event requests are disabled until server permissions are verified.

denied.title: Audit log access denied
denied.body: The server refused to provide events. Check the account permissions.

missing.title: Audit source unavailable
missing.body: The audit table was not found or is not exposed through the API. Contact the backend developer.

unavailable.title: Could not load the audit log
unavailable.body: Try again. An error does not mean there are no events.

invalid.title: Could not read the audit log
invalid.body: The request parameters or server response do not match the expected format.
